nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Micro-Exfoliating Astringent Toner for Oily Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report less shine, tighter-looking pores, and effective removal of excess oil, though a few say they saw no change in oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry either found the toner unexpectedly non-drying and hydrating or, conversely, said it made their skin noticeably drier and tight.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers mostly say it balances oil, shrinks pores and works well on oily areas without over-drying dry patches, calling it a good but not essential match.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is surprisingly gentle, non-burning and non-irritating even on reactive or acne-prone sensitive skin, while others report stinging, redness, dryness, or increased breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature or aging skin (40s-60s) report it as lightweight, non-drying and better than long-used department-store toners, helping with dryness and occasional breakouts without irritation.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers in their 50s-60s report the toner is hydrating enough for aging skin and helped after other toners stopped working, with no mentions of it worsening wrinkles or fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it tones without stripping or dehydrating skin and even helps with flakiness; a notable minority (including one sensitive-skin and one oily-skin reviewer) report it left their face dry, tight, or red, especially in early use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers note it does not cause redness and even reduces existing redness over time; a few sensitive-skin users report temporary redness or irritation after application.
concerns.barrier: A handful of reviewers describe stinging or tingling after use, usually subsiding within minutes and considered tolerable, while others explicitly praise the absence of any burning or stinging sensation.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with blackheads and clogged pores frequently report visibly smaller, less visible pores and fewer blackheads after weeks of use, though a few say they saw no real change in pore size.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, or lighter acne scars over time; a few with active breakouts say it stung or irritated existing pimples and one reports it broke her out more.
concerns.oiliness: Many oily-skin reviewers report noticeably less shine and oil control lasting into the next day, but a couple of reviewers state they saw no reduction in oiliness at all.

extraits.texte: This product broke my face out more than anything. It left my face feeling oily. I have sensetive skin and was told/ did my research on how this product was supposed to be good for sesetive skin, but that was not the case for me.

This is probably my favorite toner for my skin. I have tried a lot in the past and this is gentle, soothing, and definitely helps with pores. This doesn't sting like harsh alcohol toners. It is perfect for my oily, sensitive, acne-prone skin.

I've been a user of a department store brand toner for over 40 years, and it worked well. But, I found as I entered my 60's, my skin was becoming dryer ( I've had oily skin, without many breakouts, all my life. Upside? No wrinkles). This particular toner didn't help anymore. I started using La Roche-Posay products last year...micellar warer, various cleansers..and liked them. Decided to give this toner a try. In a word..wonderful! It's lightweight, non-drying. Makes my skin feel clean, and that I've gotten rid of every last trace of cleanser. It has a water-like feel to it, which is what I love about it. I've tried other brands' "gentle" toners. All of them left a film on my face. This one does not. My only complaint is that it doesn't come in a larger size. I go through a bottle a month! Like I mentioned, I was a dedicated customer of another brand for over 40 years. Not anymore. La Roche-Posay is my new "go-to" brand for skin care.

I am in my early 50's i still have (had) the occasional break out AND getting wrinkles to boot. how unfair is that right ? Anyway, I had a hard time finding something for older skin and acne that wouldn't leave my skin dry and irritated. I have a box FULL of failed attempts. Until now .. I first used this product without the toner as i was concerned a toner would be too drying. After that product worked i decided to try this with the toner in it. I got just a small bottle only to fine that I LOVED IT. I have sensitive skin and this product does not burn or irritate like some toners do and leaves my skin smooth clean and soft. I did try washing my face and then followed up with this toner/cleanser and i was amazed at amount of dirt my previous routine left behind and this toner picked up. Clean non drying with a mild toner ... i hope to never be without this product.

extraits.titre: Far Better than Cosmetic Counter Brands
extraits.texte: I have been a repeat customer of this product and have tried just about every brand of toner that is on the market and this is just wonderful not over drying for sensitive skin, great for cystic acne no strong smell and not expensive it lasts about 6 months when used everyday! Don't hesitate to try it's truly a great product. Does not make your face all red perfect for using before applying makeup or after cleansing your face

tighten pores without dehydration/stripping of skin, made sure to get the stubborn makeup out my pores, but i only used it directly on my pores because it irritated my already existing breakouts, would definitely recommend if you're looking for something to minimize the appearance of your pores, if you have dry skin i recommend to use good hydrating moisturizer

extraits.titre: my skin started getting so dry
extraits.texte: Hi, I have been using this toner and gel for oily skin for a week now, but my skin started getting so dry. Maybe it's the initial stage, then it will pass, something is wrong?
